description: Elections Commission - E. L. D. A. N. Keerthi of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of United National Party - M. Chamila of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated his office of the member of the United National Party
reasoning: This gazette content contains a notice under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that a member of the Kolonnawa Urban Council has vacated their office due to ceasing to be a member of a political party. This directly relates to electoral processes and local government elections, specifically addressing the vacation of office by an elected member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
